title: Graph Traversal Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners pick a start node and a traversal pattern (neighbors, within two hops, or shortest path), predict the result, then reveal it, with each hop compared to a relational JOIN.

learningObjectives: Perform graph traversals by selecting starting nodes and traversal patterns to find connected nodes.

keyQuestions: Perform graph traversals by selecting starting nodes and traversal patterns to find connected nodes.
commonMisconceptions: Traversal performance doesn't depend on graph size.
Traversal is the same as JOIN.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct predictions for all three patterns from at least one start node.
Learner can explain why A-B-D-E and A-C-D-E are both valid shortest paths.
